direction.camera: Guide attention with numeric emphasis; use a deliberate hold, a measured approach and a stable payoff.
direction.composition: let one meaningful number take the hero position; keep one dominant focal hierarchy and legible supporting evidence.
direction.editing: Open with performance beat; alternate proof and breathing room, then resolve with confident cadence.
direction.lighting: crisp directional key; preserve subject contour and separate it from the supporting field.
direction.materials: graphite and illuminated markings; actual material appearance comes from approved imagery or a real 3D asset.
direction.sound: Create a restrained rhythm around clean spec; place licensed accents on intentional cuts and keep speech clear.
direction.typography: Use numeric emphasis,performance beat,precise hit,short contrast,clean spec,confident cadence as hierarchy cues; keep display copy short and body copy readable at final delivery size.
